verdict.rationale: Mastra's own docs say it tracks latency and other run metrics across production agent runs, and offers a searchable timeline of model and tool calls. That covers a small slice of the story: latency visibility. Nothing in the evidence shows these metrics exporting to an external observability stack, nor any alerting. missing for 10: export to external observability backends (e.g. OpenTelemetry/Prometheus), failure-rate metrics, queue-depth metrics, alerting on workflow misbehavior, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, failure rates, latencies, and queue depths export to my observability stack, and alerts fire when workflows misbehave

citations.quote: Track latency, cost, model calls, and tool usage across every production agent run.
Inspect every model call, tool call, and handoff from one searchable timeline.
